intro: Professionals and everyday users convert grams (g) to ounces (oz) when working across metric and imperial standards in engineering specifications, international trade documentation, and technical measurements. One gram equals 0.035274 ounces, while 1 ounce equals 28.349523 grams. Whether you are verifying mass & weight specifications on imported equipment, cross-checking technical datasheets, or scaling practical measurements, this converter applies the exact NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 reference relationship with instant precision.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: Avoirdupois Ounces (oz) vs. Precious Metal Troy Ounces (oz t) vs. Fluid Ounces (fl oz)
items: Standard grocery and postal scales use the Avoirdupois ounce (1 oz = 28.349523125 g). Gold, silver, and platinum bullion use the Troy ounce (1 oz t = 31.1034768 g), which is 9.7% heavier.
Never confuse dry weight ounces (oz) with liquid volume fluid ounces (fl oz); they only match numerically for pure water at standard density.

faqs.question: How many ounces (oz) are in 1 gram (g)?
faqs.answer: There are 0.03527396 ounces (oz) in 1 gram (g), which rounds to 0.0353 oz for everyday calculations. Conversely, 1 ounce equals 28.349523 grams.

faqs.question: How do I convert grams to ounces (g to oz)?
faqs.answer: To convert grams to ounces, use the formula: oz = g × 0.03527396. For example, converting 100 g gives 3.5274 oz.

faqs.question: What is 100 grams in ounces?
faqs.answer: 100 grams (g) equals exactly 3.5274 ounces (oz) using standard NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 conversion factors.
